parameters.matrix: Z = B @ G @ X, with G=E@E.T and X=U diag(1/sqrt(lambda + regularization)) from G's eigendecomposition; rows normalized to unit overlap before KMeans.
parameters.distance: For normalized character rows, semantic overlap is cosine similarity Z_unit @ Z_unit.T; cosine distance is 1 - overlap.
parameters.k_selection: smallest K with radius_ratio <= 2.0 and min cluster size >= 3; fallback is lowest radius_ratio.
parameters.cluster_descriptor_fit: greedy nonnegative fit of each normalized cluster centroid using original local descriptor atoms; stop at cosine fit >= 0.95 or 12 terms.
parameters.recursive_split_rule: accept a 2-way split only if both children have >= 3 characters, mean cosine distance drops by >= 0.1, and child centroids are at least 0.04 cosine-distance apart.
